Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

Approval of Exchange of Excess Proposition A Local Return Transit Program Funds with the Palos Verdes Peninsula Transit Authority to Benefit the City's General Fund in the Amount of $502,142
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council authorize the exchange of excess $699,522 Proposition A Local Return Program (restricted use) funds with the Palos Verdes Peninsula Transit Authority to benefit the City's General Fund in the amount of $502,142, approve the Assignment Agreement, and authorize the Mayor to sign the agreement.
Staff Report
4.
PW-639-16; Completion of Contract for FY 16/17 Slurry Seal Project and Filing Notice of Completion
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council accept as complete construction contract PW 639-16 FY 16/17 Slurry Seal Project in the amount of $203,640.90, direct the City Clerk's office to file the Notice of Completion, and release the 5% retention 30 days after the County Recorder's office records the Notice of Completion, if no stop notices are filed.

Staff Report
7.
Traffic Safety Committee Meeting Items of April 5, 2017
Recommendation: Review and Approve.
a.
Via Opata Request for Speed Control and Traffic Management.
Action: Recommendation to support staff recommendation to trim or remove hedge between 4049 Via Pima and 4044 Via Opata to the property line, and to maintain plantings to a maximum of less than 30 inches in height within the City right-of-way. (5-0 in favor)
b.
Review of the Malaga Cove Plaza Parking Control Plan and Survey Results.
Action: The TSC received and filed the information provided in the staff report with the general recommendation to notify businesses and residents of locations of underutilized parking, to enhance parking enforcement, to collect additional data and schedule a midday fieldtrip for Traffic Committee Members to observe parking sometime in the future. (no motion/no vote)
Staff Report
8.
Parklands Committee Meeting Items of April 13, 2017
Recommendation: Review and Approve.
a.
PC-454-17; Application to retain private plantings located in the Parklands and in Montemar Path West adjacent to 1525 Via Montemar
Applicant: Vilma Beranek
1525 Via Montemar
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Action: Recommendation to deny PC-454-17; an application to retain private plantings in the Parklands and in Montemar Path West and require removal of all plantings, sprinklers and private non-native plantings in Montemar Path West and the Parklands at the rear of the property. Staff to review the rail road tie steps and stacked walls for further recommendations. Require the path and the Parklands to be cleared and graded to restore the natural grade. Require a native plant restoration plan to be reviewed first by staff and subsequently the Parklands Committee for approval with a legal contract between the City and property owner defining a maintenance schedule and standards that run in perpetuity with the property. (5-0, in favor).
b.
PC-455-17; Application to retain private plantings in Parklands and Montemar Path West located adjacent to 1601 Via Arriba
Applicant: Stephen and Deborah Dinsmore
1601 Via Arriba
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Action: Recommendation to deny PC-455-17; an application to retain private plantings in the Parklands and Montemar Path West located adjacent to 1601 Via Arriba and require removal of irrigation, vegetation and walls within the pathway. The applicant is to work with staff to review the retention of the rail road tie wall and lawn. Require a contract between the city and the applicant defining maintenance standards to run in perpetuity with the property. Require native plant restoration for the Parklands at the rear be submitted and approved by the Parklands Committee. Chair Wade recommended an amendment requiring all hardscape be removed unless in the judgement of staff it is in the best interest of safety and geological stability to remain. Richie-Bray and Rubincam agreed to the amendment. (5-0, in favor).
c.
PC-458-17; Application to retain private plantings and nonstandard encroachments located in Parklands adjacent to 1521 Via Montemar
Applicant: Pat Estabrook
1521 Via Montemar
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Action: Recommendation to deny PC-458-17; an application to retain private plantings and nonstandard encroachments located in the Parklands adjacent to 1521 Via Montemar, to require removal of all unpermitted private plantings, patio, irrigation, drain, bird bath, planters, rail road tie steps and border encroachments in the Parklands adjacent to 1521 Via Montemar in such a way that if a path or steps for egress and ingress into Parklands can be retained, it be done for the safety and security of the Parklands. Require a contract between the city and the applicant defining maintenance standards to run in perpetuity with the property. The vote was (3-2, in favor, Kaviani and Richie-Bray dissenting).
d.
PC-457-17; Application to retain private plantings and nonstandard encroachments located in the Parklands adjacent to 4149 Via Solano
Applicant: Robert Saucedo
4149 Via Solano
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Action: Recommendation to deny PC-456-17; an application to retain private plantings and nonstandard encroachments located in the Parklands adjacent to 4149 Via Solano to require removal of all unpermitted private plantings, hedge, garden wall/planter and sprinklers in the Parklands at the rear of the property. Require the Parklands to be cleared and graded to restore the natural grade. (5-0, in favor).
e.
PC-460-17; Application for private plantings and nonstandard encroachments located in Parklands adjacent to 2213 Paseo Del Mar
Applicant: Donald Campbell
2213 Paseo Del Mar
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Action: Recommended to approve PC-460-17; an application for private plantings and nonstandard encroachments located in Parklands adjacent to 2213 Paseo Del Mar to retain the plantings with the detailed provisions discussed here including the arching of the hedge to the thirteen feet line. Require a contract between the city and the applicant defining maintenance standards to run in perpetuity with the property. (5-0, in favor).
f.
PC-461-17; Application to remove 1 Carob tree located in the parkway adjacent to 2912 Via Rivera and remove 1 Carob tree located in the parkway adjacent to 2917 Via Rivera
Applicant: Megan Ebenhack
3004 Via Victoria
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Action: Recommended to approve PC-461-17; an application to remove 1 Carob tree located in the parkway adjacent to 2912 Via Rivera according to the â€˜Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals.â€™ Require a payment of $500 to the â€˜Tree Bankâ€™ and stump removal. (5-0, in favor).
Staff Report
OLD BUSINESS
9.
Discussion of Budget Policy Direction for Modifying the Fiscal Year 2017-18 Budget to Accommodate a Reduction of 25% of City Revenue
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide direction for developing the FY 2017-18 budget shortfall and resolving the City's structural deficit, including but not limited to, determining how to address the immediate budget shortfall, allocating fiscal reserves; considering studies to evaluate policing services, evaluating alternative funding and new revenue opportunities, establishing a framework to provide direction for moving forward; and engaging the community in the process as enumerated in the staff report.
Staff Report
